<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, ref } from 'vue'
import { createPhotoStore, type Photo } from '../stores/photos'
import { saveDemoPhoto } from '../utils/photo'
import { uploadFile, resolveAssetUrl } from '../utils/upload'
import { getCurrentPlace, reacquireLocationPermission, formatTime, type GeoPlace } from '../utils/geo'
import { applyWatermark } from '../utils/watermark'

const isRemote = (import.meta.env.VITE_DATA_MODE ?? 'demo') !== 'demo'
const persist = isRemote ? uploadFile : saveDemoPhoto

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  modelValue: Photo[]
  scope: string
  hint?: string
  disabled?: boolean
  maxCount?: number
}>(), { maxCount: 5 })

const emit = defineEmits<{ 'update:modelValue': [photos: Photo[]] }>()
const maxCount = computed(() => props.maxCount ?? 5)

const store = createPhotoStore(persist, `photos-${props.scope}`, maxCount.value)()
store.restore(props.modelValue ?? [])
watchModel()

function watchModel() {
  // 双向同步由父级控制，这里仅恢复初始值
}

import { watch } from 'vue'
watch(() => props.modelValue, value => { if (JSON.stringify(value) !== JSON.stringify(store.items)) store.restore(value ?? []) }, { deep: true })
watch(() => store.items, items => emit('update:modelValue', items.map(item => ({ ...item }))), { deep: true })

/* ===== 定位状态：未获取到地点不允许拍照 ===== */
const place = ref<GeoPlace | null>(null)
const locating = ref(false)
const locError = ref('')
const denied = ref(false)

async function locate() {
  if (locating.value) return
  locating.value = true
  locError.value = ''
  denied.value = false
  try {
    place.value = await getCurrentPlace()
  } catch (error) {
    place.value = null
    locError.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : '无法获取当前位置'
    denied.value = Boolean((error as { denied?: boolean })?.denied)
  } finally {
    locating.value = false
  }
}

/** 重新获取位置权限（此前拒绝授权时引导开启） */
async function reacquire() {
  if (locating.value) return
  locating.value = true
  locError.value = ''
  try {
    await reacquireLocationPermission()
    place.value = await getCurrentPlace()
    denied.value = false
  } catch (error) {
    place.value = null
    locError.value = error instanceof Error ? error.message : '无法获取当前位置'
    denied.value = true
  } finally {
    locating.value = false
  }
}

const placeText = computed(() => (place.value ? place.value.address : '正在获取位置…'))

onMounted(() => { locate() })

/* ===== 拍照并加水印 ===== */
const busy = ref(false)
async function shoot() {
  if (props.disabled || busy.value) return
  // 没有地点不允许提交拍照
  if (!place.value) {
    uni.showToast({ title: locError.value || '未获取到位置，无法拍照', icon: 'none' })
    if (denied.value) reacquire()
    else locate()
    return
  }
  if (store.items.length >= maxCount.value) { uni.showToast({ title: `最多${maxCount.value}张`, icon: 'none' }); return }
  uni.chooseImage({
    count: maxCount.value - store.items.length,
    sizeType: ['compressed'],
    // 仅调起相机，禁止从相册随意选已有文件/照片
    sourceType: ['camera'],
    success: async result => {
      busy.value = true
      try {
        const paths = result.tempFilePaths as string[]
        for (const path of paths) {
          // 拍照瞬间再次确认地点有效
          if (!place.value) { uni.showToast({ title: '未获取到位置，无法拍照', icon: 'none' }); break }
          const marked = await applyWatermark(path, { address: place.value.address, time: Date.now() })
          await store.add([marked])
        }
      } catch (error) {
        uni.showToast({ title: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '照片保存失败', icon: 'none' })
      } finally {
        busy.value = false
      }
    },
    fail: result => { if (!String(result.errMsg).includes('cancel')) uni.showToast({ title: '无法拍照，请检查相机权限', icon: 'none' }) },
  })
}

function preview(url: string) { uni.previewImage({ current: resolveAssetUrl(url), urls: store.items.filter(item => item.status === 'done').map(item => resolveAssetUrl(item.url)) }) }
function show(photo: Photo) { return photo.source && /^(blob:|data:)/i.test(photo.source) ? photo.source : resolveAssetUrl(photo.url) }
</script>

<template>
  <view class="wm-camera">
    <view class="wm-loc" :class="{ error: !!locError }">
      <text class="wm-loc-icon">📍</text>
      <text v-if="locating" class="wm-loc-text">正在获取位置…</text>
      <text v-else-if="place" class="wm-loc-text">{{ place.address }}</text>
      <text v-else class="wm-loc-text">{{ locError || '未获取到位置' }}</text>
      <text v-if="!locating && !place" class="wm-loc-action" role="button" @click="denied ? reacquire() : locate()">{{ denied ? '重新获取位置权限' : '重新获取位置' }}</text>
